course.title: Exploring Our World
course.description: Discover how people, places, communities, and decisions shape the world around us.

sections.title: History & Human Stories
sections.question: How have people, ideas, and events shaped the world we live in?
sections.description: Explore how people, ideas, inventions, movement, and trade have shaped the world.

sections.title: Geography & Our Environment
sections.question: How do places shape people's lives, and how do people shape places?
sections.description: Understand maps, places, resources, climate, cities, and the relationship between people and the environment.

sections.title: Culture, Society & Identity
sections.question: How do people create meaning, community, and belonging?
sections.description: Learn how communities create meaning through language, traditions, art, everyday life, and shared experiences.

sections.title: Civics, Media & Everyday Economics
sections.question: How do people make choices, use resources, and build fairer communities together?
sections.description: Explore everyday economics, media literacy, and how young people can contribute to their communities.
